trending_top_6.details: India Post GDS Result 2026 has released on 12 October 2026 for 23,757 Gramin Dak Sevak, Branch Postmaster (BPM) and Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM)/Dak Sevak vacancies under Schedule-II, July 2026.
